title: Pah Vung Wei

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 906
Date 18/2/17

Shanghai Municipal Council

February 8th 1917.

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,

It is reported that following the usual
custom General Lu entertained all the Loongwha
military officers on the occasion of the lantern
festival on the 6th inst.
It is reported that the Vice President
has received a telegram from Peking pointing
out that the United States are on the verge
of war with Germany and instructing him to
ascertain the opinions of all the senior
military officers under his command as to
the advisability or otherwise of maintaining
neutrality should war be declared.
One of the well known Koh Ming Tang
leaders Pah Yung Wei 柏文蔚 will leave Peking
en route for Shanghai today and will arrive
in three or four days. His visit is said
to be in connection with the opium trade.
During the last two days gangs of
ex-rebels have been making a round of the
pawnshops in the City begging.
Sun Yat Sen is receiving $3,000.00
per month from Peking.
An American Jew who bears the name
of Barnes Moss and who was formerly the
agent for the Sun Life Assurance Company
of Canada has been attached to the Staff
of Yang Ching, Envoy for Foreign Affairs.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：）
Entered on
M.J. 7.6.8.

（左下角批注：）
Art!

page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号 906
日期 17/2/18

上海工部局

1917年2月8日。

警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，依照惯例，卢将军于本月6日元宵节之际，宴请了所有龙华的军官。

据报，副总统已收到来自北京的一份电报，指出美国正处于与德国战争的边缘，并指示他征询其麾下所有高级军官的意见，以确定若宣战的话，保持中立是否适宜。

著名的哥民党（音译）领导人之一柏文蔚将于今日离开北京前往上海，预计三至四天后抵达。据说他的此行与鸦片贸易有关。

在过去两天里，一群前叛乱分子一直在城内各家当铺巡回乞讨。

孙中山每月从北京领取3,000.00美元。

一位名叫巴恩斯·莫斯（Barnes Moss）的美籍犹太人，曾任加拿大永明人寿保险公司（Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada）的代理人，现已附属于外交专员杨庆（音译）的幕僚团队。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmstrong
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

（左侧批注：）
录入于
M.J. 7.6.8.

（左下角批注：）
Art!
8/2

（底部签名：）
by c.l.p.
